key_judgments.title: The defects are the agency's template, not the owner's choices
key_judgments.judgment: It is likely that the recurring defects on The Bugman are inherited from the Coalmarch Marketing (now Scorpion) template and platform rather than owned by the business, because The shared sprowt3 Drupal template, the GTM-that-fires-before-any-consent-gate pattern, the Universal-Analytics-id-left-in-container pattern, the Product-schema-on-a-service pattern and the long-title/thin-meta pattern are template-level, so they are inherited from the agency, not owned by the business.
falsifiers: A sibling site on the same template without the same defect would weaken this.
An owner-made change that post-dates the agency build would reassign ownership.

key_judgments.title: A challenger can lead with a clean ownership-and-diagnosis contrast
key_judgments.judgment: It is likely that a challenger who leads with a declared audit plus true site ownership can open a conversation, because the lock-in and the inherited defects are public and documented.
falsifiers: A long contract term with heavy exit penalties would lengthen the cycle.
High owner satisfaction despite the defects would weaken the wedge.

findings.title: The site is walled to a declared crawler (WAF challenge)
findings.evidence: https://www.thebugman.com/ returns a Cloudflare managed challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge) to the declared OmegaWeapon user-agent, and robots.txt allows crawling. The on-page read is NOT_TESTED and becomes a verify task.
findings.fix: Confirm the WAF is not challenging Googlebot/Bingbot (verify-googlebot on a log, or GSC URL Inspection); a wall that catches real crawlers suppresses indexation.

glossary.def: A finding is inherited when it comes from the agency's shared template or platform, owned when the business controls it. It decides who fixes it and who to lead the pitch against.
Ad/analytics tags that run before any consent choice. A privacy exposure under US state laws and GDPR; cheap to fix with a consent banner.
Using schema.org/Product for a service. It has no rich-result path for services and can misdescribe the business to answer engines.
Scorpion's hosting platform. A client site resolving into the scorpcloud CNAME zone is on Scorpion's proprietary CMS - the central lock-in.
A fetch-only run with no client exports. Rankings, traffic and spend are protocols or inferred, not measured.
The intelligence-community probability scale (almost no chance ... almost certain) used so a likelihood word always maps to a number range.
